title: 21st Anniversary of CSAF Rescue
description: Quick clip of Airmen from the 55th Rescue Squadron, both deployed and at Davis-Monthan Air Force Base, gathering to celebrate the 21st Anniversary of their unit's rescue of the 21st Chief of Staff of the Air Force. A speech was given by the 355th Vice Wing Commander.

transcript.text: What we do is significant . It's
important to tell you a little story .
Six months ago , I had the opportunity
to go to the Pentagon for the Cheney
Award . We were in the vice chief's
office and all throughout the office ,
60 70 years of history and heritage .
One thing caught my eye . I looked at
his desk . Of all the squadrons in our
United States Air Force , he has two
patches . One was from his squadron ,
the triple nickel , and the second was
the jolly green patch . That's a symbol
of what our team did 21 years ago .
It's our moral imperative that for each
soldier , sailor , airman and marine on
the battlefield , just like May 2nd
1999 we will be there . So , Chief ,
I leave you with this
rescue and attack fights
on .
